rules.name: Mandatory CR Conformity Mark for Children's Toys (QCVN 3:2019/BKHCN)
rules.title: Mandatory CR Conformity Mark for Children's Toys (QCVN 3:2019/BKHCN)
rules.expected_requirement: All toys manufactured domestically or imported into Vietnam must undergo state quality inspection, conform to QCVN 3:2019/BKHCN, and bear the CR Conformity Mark.
rules.explanation: Importing toys without the CR mark and certificate of conformity is a violation of Circular 09/2019/TT-BKHCN; uncertified consignments are held by Vietnam Customs.
rules.fix_suggestion: Submit product samples to an accredited Vietnamese conformity assessment body, receive the Certificate of Conformity, and affix the CR Mark.

rules.name: Mandatory Vietnamese Sub-Labeling (Nhãn Phụ) Standard
rules.title: Mandatory Vietnamese Sub-Labeling (Nhãn Phụ) Standard
rules.directive_code: Decree No. 43/2017/ND-CP & Decree No. 111/2021/ND-CP on Goods Labels
rules.statute_citation: Decree No. 43/2017/ND-CP & Decree No. 111/2021/ND-CP on Goods Labels
rules.expected_requirement: Imported goods must have supplementary Vietnamese sub-labels (Nhãn phụ) displaying product name, origin, name and address of importer, manufacturing date, expiry, and safety warnings.
rules.explanation: Under Decree 43/2017, commercial goods sold in Vietnam without complete Vietnamese sub-labels are penalized and prohibited from retail circulation.
rules.fix_suggestion: Attach a supplementary Vietnamese label (Nhãn phụ) to the retail packaging prior to customs release and marketplace distribution.

rules.name: Mandatory Cosmetic Product Proclamation (Notification)
rules.title: Mandatory Cosmetic Product Proclamation (Notification)
rules.directive_code: Circular No. 06/2011/TT-BYT on Cosmetic Management / Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV)
rules.statute_citation: Circular No. 06/2011/TT-BYT on Cosmetic Management / Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV)
rules.expected_requirement: Imported cosmetics must have a Cosmetic Product Proclamation Report (Phiếu công bố sản phẩm mỹ phẩm) approved by the Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV) with a valid receipt number.
rules.explanation: Cosmetic consignments without an approved DAV proclamation receipt number cannot clear Vietnam Customs.
rules.fix_suggestion: Obtain a Certificate of Free Sale (CFS) from origin country and submit online proclamation via the National Single Window portal to obtain the DAV receipt number.

rules.name: Law on Advertising Prohibition of False Curative Claims
rules.title: Law on Advertising Prohibition of False Curative Claims
rules.expected_requirement: Prohibition of advertising that misleads consumers into believing cosmetic products have therapeutic, healing, or disease-curing medicinal properties.
rules.explanation: Labeling cosmetic pain creams with claims to permanently cure arthritis or treat illnesses violates Vietnam advertising and drug safety laws.
rules.fix_suggestion: Adjust product copy to describe moisturizing, skin softening, or gentle massage benefits.

rules.name: QCVN 12 Food Contact Safety Standards for Kitchenware
rules.title: QCVN 12 Food Contact Safety Standards for Kitchenware
rules.directive_code: National Technical Regulation QCVN 12-1:2011/BYT / Food Safety Law No. 55/2010/QH12
rules.statute_citation: National Technical Regulation QCVN 12-1:2011/BYT / Food Safety Law No. 55/2010/QH12
rules.expected_requirement: Kitchen utensils, wooden boards, and food contact packaging must pass safety and hygiene tests under QCVN 12-1:2011/BYT.
rules.explanation: Food contact articles releasing toxic chemical residues or heavy metals fail state food safety inspection.
rules.fix_suggestion: Test cutting boards for heavy metal migration and chemical leaching at an authorized MoH testing center.

rules.name: MIC Type Approval & Conformity Mark for Electronics
rules.title: MIC Type Approval & Conformity Mark for Electronics
rules.directive_code: Circular No. 02/2024/TT-BTTTT / Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC)
rules.statute_citation: Circular No. 02/2024/TT-BTTTT / Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC)
rules.expected_requirement: Rechargeable electronic and wireless consumer products must obtain MIC Type Approval and Declaration of Conformity with the ICT conformity mark (Dấu hợp quy).
rules.explanation: Customs requires Type Approval certificates for devices containing lithium batteries and wireless transmitters before clearance.
rules.fix_suggestion: Conduct testing at an MIC-designated laboratory, file Declaration of Conformity, and affix ICT conformity mark.
